paragraphs: R' Hanina ben Shayla. See the entry R' Hinena ben Shayla (ב״ש).[^1]

notes.text: The heading supplies ben Shayla for ב״ש. Hanina (חנינא) and Hinena (חיננא) remain distinct. The supplied patronymic is שיילא; earlier machine OCR had שילא, rather than two verified printed patronymics. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
